dedupe_keys.name: starkregenrisikomanagement srrm kritische objekte mit offentlichem bezug kreis viersen

description: Starkregenrisikomanagement (SRRM) - Kritische Objekte mit öffentlichem Bezug Kreis Viersen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kreis Viersen. Public buildings such as schools, kindergartens, retirement homes. Without classification according to heavy rain risk. Supplement layer for map building risk exceptional circle Viersen. Coverage: Kreis Viersen. The portal shows the English title as "Heavy rain risk management (SRRM) - Critical objects with public reference Kreis Viersen" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Kreis Viersen. Its keywords include Tönisvorst, Unterführung, Willich, kritisch, Wasserhöhe, Nettetal. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
